subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board continued its Chapter 40B hearing for 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway, receiving peer review presentations on traffic impacts and architectural design. No final action was taken on the permit, and the hearing was continued to March 13, 2023.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway: Traffic Peer Review
items.summary: Tetra Tech presented its traffic peer review concerning pedestrian access to Wellington Station, site driveways, and loading logistics, and the applicant agreed to conduct updated traffic and parking counts.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway: Architectural Peer Review
items.summary: Cliff Boehmer of Davis Square Architects presented the design peer review, recommending dedicated on-site open space such as a tot lot, larger setbacks along Commercial Street, and clearer operational plans for deliveries and drop-offs.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway: Design Public Comment and Board Discussion
items.summary: The board discussed incorporating public art and reopened public comment to hear feedback from Community Development Board member Claes Andreasen regarding open space and building drop-off locations.

items.title: Hearing Continuance
items.summary: The board voted to continue the public hearing for 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway to March 13, 2023.

items.title: Administrative Business
items.summary: Staff reviewed upcoming member term expirations to arrange staggered reappointments, and announced multiple vacant municipal planning positions.
